tasks.title: block-destructive-git force-push match stays inside one command
tasks.notes: The force-push pattern allows any gap between "push" and the flag, so a later "rm -f" after a semicolon trips it (2026-10-12, twice; also blocked a tasks.sh call whose notes quoted that shape). Bound the gap to a class without ; & |. Bats: push-then-semicolon-rm passes; push with -f or --force to main still blocks.
